内置服务不支持该请求。: The built-in service does not support this request.
达到开始阈值后，后台会禁用适配器并增加 CPU 负载。温度过高时会暂停负载；关闭: At the start threshold, BatteryCare disables the adapter and increases CPU load. Load pauses if the temperature is too high. Turning this off stops the load and attempts to restore charging.
参数无效：停止阈值必须小于开始阈值；温度 40–100°C，轮询 5–3600: Invalid settings: the stop threshold must be below the start threshold; temperature: 40–100°C; polling: 5–3600 seconds.
请在系统设置 → 通用 → 登录项中允许 BatteryCare。: Allow BatteryCare in System Settings → General → Login Items.
内置电源控制已就绪；旧服务（如有）已备份停用。自动耗电仍需手动开启。: Built-in power control is ready. Any legacy service was backed up and disabled. Auto discharge still needs to be enabled manually.
无需安装外置服务；打开 App 即开始监测。: No external service is needed. Monitoring starts with the app.
退出 App，并停止耗电、恢复适配器: Quit, stop discharge and restore the adapter
原生菜单栏 · App 内置控制引擎: Native menu bar · Built-in control engine
登录时启动 App 和内置监测；自动耗电不会随启动自动开启。: Start the app and monitoring at login. Auto discharge never starts automatically.
打开系统菜单栏设置，由你选择是否显示原生电池图标: Open System Settings to choose whether to show the system battery icon
在系统设置 → 菜单栏中，取消勾选「电池」即可隐藏原生图标。旧版 macOS 位: In System Settings → Menu Bar, turn off Battery to hide the system icon. On older macOS versions, use Control Center → Battery → Show in Menu Bar. This does not affect BatteryCare or charging.
达到高阈值开始耗电，降至低阈值停止。增加 CPU 负载会消耗电量并产生热量；仅在: Discharge starts at the upper threshold and stops at the lower threshold. Extra CPU load drains the battery and generates heat. Enable only when needed.
内置监测启动后即可编辑参数。: Settings are available once monitoring starts.
服务现已集成在 App 内，无需 Python 或独立 LaunchDaemon: The service is built into the app. No Python or separate LaunchDaemon is needed. Closing Settings keeps it running; quitting stops the load and restores the adapter.
耗电负载已停止，但无法确认适配器已恢复: Load stopped, but adapter recovery could not be confirmed
App 内缺少 BatteryHardware，请重新构建。: BatteryHardware is missing from the app. Please rebuild.
未获得管理员授权，未开启耗电。: Administrator authorization was not granted. Discharge was not enabled.
内置电源助手未能启动。请确认硬件支持适配器控制，或重试迁移旧服务。: The power helper could not start. Check hardware support for adapter control, or retry legacy service migration.
内置监测已启动 · 检测到旧服务，需迁移后启用控制: Monitoring active · Migrate the legacy service before enabling control
内置服务运行中 · 电源控制已授权: Built-in service active · Power control authorized
内置服务运行中 · 首次控制需要管理员授权: Built-in service active · Power control needs administrator authorization
运行参数超出安全范围。: Control settings exceed the safe range.
电源助手连接已断开，自动耗电已安全停用。: The power helper disconnected. Auto discharge has been disabled for safety.
电量或 CPU 温度不可用，已暂停耗电并恢复适配器。: Battery level or CPU temperature is unavailable. Discharge paused and the adapter was restored.
language.title: Language
language.hint: Changes apply immediately and are remembered. The system language is used on first launch.
panel.actions: Left-click for panel; right-click for quick actions
quit.recovery: Return to the app to retry. If you quit anyway, the helper will attempt recovery after the connection expires.
menubar.position.title: Menu bar position
menubar.position.hint: Starts near the right-hand system icons when possible. Hold ⌘ and drag to fine-tune; your position is remembered. macOS controls the final order.
discharge.adaptive.hint: Adaptive CPU-only load: at most 4 workers and half the logical cores (minimum 1), up to 85% duty per worker. Effective CPU cutoff is the lower of your setting and 75°C. Thermal pressure reduces or stops load. No added GPU or disk workload; zero wear is not guaranteed.
耗电开关开启且安全条件满足时防止闲置熄屏；不模拟接通电源，不覆盖合盖睡眠。: Prevents idle display sleep while auto discharge is enabled and safety checks pass. Does not simulate AC power or override lid-close sleep.
已防止闲置熄屏 · 不覆盖合盖睡眠: Idle display sleep prevented · lid-close sleep unchanged
